title: Issue 2822 deterministic Structured Executor kernel

intent.outcome: Build the maintainer-only deterministic Structured Executor kernel for #2822 with versioned contracts, a pure reducer, atomic local persistence, deterministic replay, revision binding, and bounded cycle/no-progress recovery.
non_goals: No AW command or subprocess execution from replay.
No repository mutation, public AW command, workflow DSL, scheduler, transcript archive, or shipped state owner.
Do not claim #2821 usefulness, efficiency, or stage-2 readiness.

refs: GitHub #2822 current issue body and implementation supplement

validation_commands: uv run --frozen --active --no-sync ruff check tools/model-cli-harness/structured-executor tests/test_structured_executor_contracts.py tests/test_structured_executor_replay.py tests/test_structured_executor_safety.py
uv run --frozen --active --no-sync python scripts/run_agentic_workspace.py proof --target . --changed <paths> --format json
completion_criteria: Versioned maintainer-only schemas validate representative state, reference, action, result, evidence/claim, terminal, and transition fixtures.
A domain-neutral pure reducer emits immutable revisioned state and complete deterministic transition identities.
Replay is byte/digest stable and invokes no model, provider, AW command, network, subprocess, or repository mutation.
Stale revisions fail without mutation; repeated state/action and no-progress loops become explicit blocked/recovery state.
Atomic persistence and interrupted-write recovery are proven; restart requires authoritative domain re-observation.
Three small stacked PRs cover the full #2822 child without claiming #2821 or stage-2 readiness.
